label: Vivinal GOS
note: FrieslandCampina; 57 % of infant formulas launched in 2025 contained GOS (NutraIngredients 2025)

about.text: The galacto-oligosaccharide ingredient of FrieslandCampina, made from lactose by an enzyme and added to infant formula and other foods to feed gut bifidobacteria.

steps.name: join with enzyme
steps.note: With beta-galactosidase from Bacillus circulans in the original grade; newer grades use enzyme from Pichia pastoris expressing a Sporobolomyces singularis gene (Vivinal GOS B) or from Papiliotrema terrestris (Vivinal GOS PT).
